### ✨ New
- **Folders can be hidden and moved.** In Edit mode, a folder has Hide/Show and Move like an app (with the remote: OK on a folder, then Reorder). A hidden folder leaves the app menu but keeps its chip in the folder bar, so it is still one press away. Settings > Folders has Hide/Show too.
- **More OLED care** (Settings > Screen): shift every 1, 3 or 5 minutes; idle after up to 30 minutes; a **Clock only** idle mode; the wallpaper can dim or pause while idle; and **Screen off** after 15 minutes to an hour on rooted TVs (any button turns it back on).
- **Wallpaper brightness** (Settings > Wallpaper) tones down a bright picture or video all the time.
- **App updates** (was App info) shows a green **Signed and installed** badge when this version came through the signed in-app updater.

### 🧭 Easier to use
- **Settings is bigger and nothing needs scrolling.** The Apps tab was split into **Apps**, **Look**, **Folders** and **Names & icons**; Names & icons is now a compact grid of icons.
- **Home button and start-up in one place** (Settings > TV): the webOS version and **Apply** or **Restore** on one row. *When the TV turns on* stays greyed out until the Home button is on, so both open OpenLauncher.
- **Clicking empty space** closes the app menu and the Running apps window. Running apps opens with nothing highlighted; the remote's first arrow press picks the first app.
- The **app menu** lines up with the bottom bar and the Recent row, keeps the same width in every folder, and stops above the Recent row whenever it fits.
- Smaller fixes: the Apps button has the same shadow as the clock and info button, rows of apps sit as close as columns (Settings > Look > Row spacing), and the App updates page lines up.

### 🛠️ For developers
- **Simulator** (`tools/simulator`): runs the launcher in Chrome with your TV's apps and settings, the remote on the keyboard and a pointer; `dev.sh` reloads it live while you edit; `record.sh` records demos.
- Fixed while testing: the Home button's Apply could fail after the TV tab's rewrite (a missing quoting helper); caught before release.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.openlauncher_3.1.0_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Dev Manager, Discoverium or `ares-install`, or use **Check for updates** in Settings > App updates.
